content:
{
  "summary": "The audit findings reveal that the bot frequently ends calls abruptly (F4) without proper closes or requirement confirmation, and logs success dispositions (F2, F6) without verifying critical details like product, quantity, or buyer corrections. The core issues are: 1) Lack of mandatory requirement read-back before collection or closing, 2) Failure to handle buyer corrections or explicit product rejections, and 3) Abrupt terminations mid-question due to loop detection or technical issues.",
  "fixes": [
    {
      "title": "Read back requirement before collection and close",
      "what_goes_wrong": "The bot asks for quantity or details without confirming the product, and closes without verifying the requirement, leading to unconfirmed or wrong leads.",
      "prompt_section": "Collection Control",
      "current_instruction": "Before asking anything, check whether the answer is already known from the product context, earlier responses, or the conversation history. Once all the required information has been collected, or there is no requirements to be collected, then immediately proceed to the FINALISATION step and end the conversation.",
      "suggested_text": "Before asking any collection question, silently confirm the requirement is understood. If product_name is set, briefly read it back: 'Ji, [product_name] ki requirement hai na?' If the buyer corrects or rejects it, update and re-confirm before proceeding. Never ask quantity, name, or location without first confirming the product requirement.",
      "why_it_helps": "Prevents unconfirmed leads and ensures the buyer's intent is captured correctly before collecting details, reducing F2 and F6 errors.",
      "calls_affected": 6,
      "fatal_codes": [
        "F2",
        "F4",
        "F6"
      ],
      "example_call_ids": [
        "90643029",
        "90643032",
        "90643036",
        "90643071",
        "91100801",
        "91229281"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Handle buyer corrections and rejections",
      "what_goes_wrong": "The bot reads back the wrong product or size, ignores buyer corrections, and proceeds to close or collect details, logging the wrong requirement.",
      "prompt_section": "Information Collection Rules",
      "current_instruction": "Capture clear buyer-provided information silently. For specification values inferred only from @ product_name , follow the Specification Collection confirmation rule.",
      "suggested_text": "If the buyer corrects a product name, size, or specification, acknowledge and update the variable immediately. Do not re-ask the corrected field unless it is still below its limit. Before closing or proceeding, read back the corrected value for confirmation: 'Ji, [corrected value] note kar liya, sahi hai?'",
      "why_it_helps": "Ensures accurate lead data by validating buyer corrections before logging or closing, reducing F2 and F6 errors from misrecorded requirements.",
      "calls_affected": 3,
      "fatal_codes": [
        "F2",
        "F6"
      ],
      "example_call_ids": [
        "90643036",
        "90643064",
        "90643051"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Stop probing after buyer rejection",
      "what_goes_wrong": "The bot continues collecting details after the buyer clearly rejects the product or says they have no requirement, logging a success disposition.",
      "prompt_section": "End-Call Disposition Table",
      "current_instruction": "If transfer consent is exhausted without agreement, do not transfer or mark silence/ambiguity as refusal. Set @ buyer_disposition and then @ call_outcome to 'BL Enriched', invoke end_interaction, and use the existing seller-details closing.",
      "suggested_text": "If the buyer explicitly rejects the product ('लो। कोई बात नहीं।'), says they have no requirement, or asks for a different product, do not collect further details. Update @ buyer_disposition to 'BL Deleted' and @ call_outcome to 'No Product Requirement', then end the call with a polite close.",
      "why_it_helps": "Prevents logging enriched leads for non-interested buyers and ensures proper closure, reducing F2 and F6 errors.",
      "calls_affected": 2,
      "fatal_codes": [
        "F2",
        "F6"
      ],
      "example_call_ids": [
        "91100801",
        "91229392"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Avoid repeated questions on the same field",
      "what_goes_wrong": "The bot asks the same question multiple times without waiting for a response, causing loops, buyer frustration, and abrupt disconnections.",
      "prompt_section": "Adaptive Follow-up — STRICT MAX 3 ATTEMPTS PER SLOT",
      "current_instruction": "Each slot may be requested at most 2 times during the entire call: Attempt 1: Initial question, Attempt 2: Final follow-up. HARD LIMIT: Never ask the same question more than 2 times, under any circumstance.",
      "suggested_text": "After 2 attempts on a field, if unanswered or unclear, mark it as exhausted. Do not ask again. Instead, briefly defer: 'Koi baat nahi, aap seller se directly discuss kar sakte hain.' Then move to the next eligible field or FINALISATION. Never ask the same question a third time.",
      "why_it_helps": "Prevents loops and abrupt disconnections caused by repeated unanswered questions, reducing F4 errors.",
      "calls_affected": 5,
      "fatal_codes": [
        "F4"
      ],
      "example_call_ids": [
        "90643033",
        "90643056",
        "90643043",
        "91229281",
        "91156758"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Close with a proper transfer offer or close",
      "what_goes_wrong": "The bot ends the call abruptly mid-sentence without a proper close, leaving the buyer hanging or without a clear next step.",
      "prompt_section": "Closing Rules",
      "current_instruction": "Every closing path must invoke end_interaction. Once a closing path is selected, do not continue requirement collection, seller probing, or intent handling. Never ask a question after entering a closing path.",
      "suggested_text": "Before ending, always provide a clear next step: either 'I will connect you to a live seller now' or 'I will send seller details on WhatsApp.' Then invoke end_interaction. Never end mid-sentence or without a clear offer.",
      "why_it_helps": "Ensures calls end with a clear resolution or transfer offer, reducing F4 errors from abrupt disconnections.",
      "calls_affected": 8,
      "fatal_codes": [
        "F4"
      ],
      "example_call_ids": [
        "91229281",
        "90643039",
        "90643059",
        "90643073",
        "90643075",
        "90643067",
        "90643064",
        "91156758"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Confirm product before logging lead",
      "what_goes_wrong": "The bot logs a lead as enriched or approved without the buyer ever confirming the requirement, or logs manual calls without confirmation.",
      "prompt_section": "Requirement Confirmation Rules",
      "current_instruction": "The requirement confirmation stage is considered complete only when the buyer's response clearly establishes their requirement for product_name.",
      "suggested_text": "Before logging any disposition (BL Approved, BL Enriched, Manual Call), ensure the buyer has explicitly confirmed the product requirement. If not confirmed, do not log success. Instead, continue confirmation or end with 'No Product Requirement' if the buyer rejects or is unclear.",
      "why_it_helps": "Prevents logging unconfirmed or wrong leads, reducing F2 and F6 errors from premature dispositions.",
      "calls_affected": 3,
      "fatal_codes": [
        "F2",
        "F6"
      ],
      "example_call_ids": [
        "91100801",
        "91156571",
        "91229392"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "not_prompt_issues": [
    "Technical call drops and ASR issues causing mid-sentence cut-offs (e.g., calls 90643029, 90643039, 90643059).",
    "System logging failures (e.g., calls 90643058, 90643069, 90643076).",
    "Buyer hanging up before the bot can close (e.g., calls 90643047, 91264775, 91046448)."
  ]
}
